command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-matched-v2.XXXXXX)

git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-eye-harness-repair-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SCRIPT="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/validate_matched_eye_ab_v2.py"

test -f "$SCRIPT"; test -f "$SHADOW"; test ! -e "$OUT"
